steps.title: Donor lifetime
steps.text: Set the donor-only lifetime in ns: type a value in Lifetime D0 and press Enter, or use the arrows.

steps.title: Förster radius
steps.text: Set R0 in Å for the donor/acceptor pair.

steps.title: Distance
steps.text: Enter the donor-acceptor distance in Å. Efficiency, lifetime and transfer rate update together.

steps.title: Inverse calculation
steps.text: Edit the efficiency to solve for the effective single distance. Broad distribution averages are not exactly invertible.

steps.title: Distance distribution
steps.text: Tick χ distribution to use the non-negative chi distance distribution instead of a Gaussian, then watch both plots change. The active distribution is solid.

steps.title: HomoFRET
steps.text: Open the HomoFRET tab: energy migration between like dyes links the migration time and the rotational correlation time to a distance.

steps.title: Migration time
steps.text: Edit the anisotropy migration time t_RM. The migration rate k_homo (read-only) and the implied distance R_DA follow.

steps.title: Back-map
steps.text: Edit the distance R_DA to solve backwards for the migration time.

steps.title: Help
steps.text: The Help button explains the quantities, the distributions and the plots. Hover any control for its unit and meaning.
